value.description:
Neoadjuvant chemotherapy consisted of adriamycine 40 mg/m2, administered on day 1 as an i.v.
infusion.
Paclitaxel 150 mg/m2 was administered on day 2 as an i.v infusión followed by gemcitabine 2000 mg/m2 as an i.v.
infusion.
The three drugs were administered every two weeks for 6 cycles.
